study_identification_part.si_4_title: Normative modeling of brain morphometry in self-limited epilepsy with centrotemporal spikes

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: devCCNP provides CKG and PEK samples for normative model training; a case-control cohort with SeLECTS and matched controls from Jinling Hospital is treated as a single-site dataset (no formal dataset name reported).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The data for model training consists of two samples: the CKG sample and the PEK sample. Samples from the two different centers are both sourced from the developing Chinese Color Nest Project (devCCNP)."; "The current work encompassed two independent cohorts: a casecontrol cohort and a normal sample for model training."; "The study protocols adhered to the Helsinki Declaration of 1975 and received approval from the medical ethics committee of Jinling Hospital, School of Medicine, Nanjing University."

answer.devCCNP: normative model training (CKG and PEK samples combined; site harmonization applied)

answer.SINGLE-SITE: case-control cohort (SeLECTS and healthy controls) used to apply normative models and compare deviations

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: devCCNP normal sample used to construct/train normative models; case-control cohort used for deviation mapping and group comparisons (single-site cohort inferred from Jinling Hospital ethics statement).
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "The data for model training consists of two samples: the CKG sample and the PEK sample. Samples from the two different centers are both sourced from the developing Chinese Color Nest Project (devCCNP). The two samples are combined to train the normative models..."; "The current work encompassed two independent cohorts: a casecontrol cohort and a normal sample for model training."; "The sex-specific and region-specific model parameters by the CentileBrain normative modeling framework were subsequently applied to each region morphometric measure of the children with SeLECTS and healthy controls."
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Yang2025.pdf.md: Participants; Yang2025.pdf.md: Computing normative deviation in children with SeLECTS
